Technology.headline: NASA to Chase Solar Eclipse at 460mph with 86 Balloons to Study Earth's Atmosphere

Simultaneously, 86 balloons will be launched to measure how the sudden darkness from the eclipse changes Earth’s atmosphere. This ambitious project aims to gather unprecedented data on atmospheric responses to solar events.
